description: Rb₂Na(NO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.34 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 3.02-3.41 Å. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.71 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) N-O bond length. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Rb and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Rb, one Na, and one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Rb, two equivalent Na, and one N atom to form distorted corner-sharing ORb₂Na₂N trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Rb, one Na, and one N atom.
